meta.source: index.html (single-file app, :root custom properties plus literal colours in its stylesheet and canvas code)

color.note: One theme. Kinetic Atlas is dark by identity, not by preference: ink-navy grounds, luminous pastel signals. Names that exist as CSS variables in the app (bg, surface, border, border2, text, soft, muted, primary, alc, caf, nic, danger, warn) keep those exact names.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, always under the two ambient glows (glow-teal top-left, glow-violet top-right).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panel and metric card base; the end stop of their gradient.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Start stop of the panel and metric gradient: linear-gradient(155deg, surface-raised, surface). Lit edge of every card.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Cards inside panels: stat boxes, insight tiles, guidance cards, dialogs. Replaces the near-identical #101a29 and #101b2a in the current file.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed fields: inputs, selects, empty state, fine print.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Track behind segmented controls and tabs; source cards; method code blocks.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Default button fill and toast.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Default button on hover.

tokens.name: tab-active
tokens.usage: Selected compound tab.

tokens.name: pill-active
tokens.usage: Selected segment in a pill control (range, scale).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel edges, dividers, table rules. Decorative only (1.4:1 on surface).

tokens.name: border2
tokens.usage: Button and tag outlines, guidance card neutral stripe. 1.8:1 on surface: shape is carried by the fill, not the line.

tokens.name: border-hover
tokens.usage: Button outline on hover.

tokens.name: input-border
tokens.usage: Input and select outline at rest. Source value, 1.8:1 on well: below the 3:1 control-border floor. Kept exact; flagged for the web-app rebuild.

tokens.name: dialog-border
tokens.usage: Dialog outline.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers, on every surface token (13:1 or more).

tokens.name: soft
tokens.usage: Paragraphs, labels and secondary values, on every surface token (8:1 or more).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Metadata, units, captions and inactive tabs, on bg, surface, surface-inset, well and track (5.2:1 or more). Not on tab-active or pill-active.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholder text on well only (4.65:1).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one brand hue. Primary button, links, focus outline, positive emphasis. Text on primary uses on-primary.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button and outline button on hover.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary or primary-hover fill (11:1).

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Wash behind an outline button on hover or focus.

tokens.name: brand-tile
tokens.usage: Fill of the brandmark tile. A touch cooler than primary; use only for the mark.

tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: The trace line drawn on brand-tile (12:1).

tokens.name: brand-glow
tokens.usage: Colour of the halo under the brandmark (see shadow-brand).

tokens.name: alc
tokens.usage: Alcohol. Peach: the warm one. Curve, compound dot, tab underline, metric glow. Readable as text on every surface (8:1 or more).

tokens.name: alc-tint
tokens.usage: Alcohol symbol tile behind the glass icon in history rows.

tokens.name: caf
tokens.usage: Caffeine. Lavender. Curve, dot, tab underline, metric glow. Text on any surface (6.9:1 or more).

tokens.name: caf-tint
tokens.usage: Caffeine symbol tile behind the steaming cup icon.

tokens.name: nic
tokens.usage: Nicotine. Aqua. Curve, dot, tab underline, metric glow. Text on any surface (9.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: nic-tint
tokens.usage: Nicotine symbol tile behind the leaf icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Urgent severity label and stripe. State only, never decoration. Text on surface, surface-inset and urgent-surface (6.7:1 or more).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Caution severity label and stripe. State only. Text on any surface (11:1 or more).

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Text in a positive tag, on success-bg (9.2:1).

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Positive tag fill.

tokens.name: success-border
tokens.usage: Positive tag outline.

tokens.name: feedback
tokens.usage: Inline confirmation under a form ("Added to timeline"), on surface-inset.

tokens.name: badge-ink
tokens.usage: Neutral status badge text, on badge-bg (7.9:1).

tokens.name: badge-bg
tokens.usage: Neutral status badge fill.

tokens.name: badge-border
tokens.usage: Neutral status badge outline.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Caution badge text, on warn-bg (9:1).

tokens.name: warn-bg
tokens.usage: Caution badge fill.

tokens.name: warn-border
tokens.usage: Caution badge outline.

tokens.name: urgent-ink
tokens.usage: Urgent badge text, on urgent-bg (8:1).

tokens.name: urgent-bg
tokens.usage: Urgent badge fill.

tokens.name: urgent-border
tokens.usage: Urgent badge outline.

tokens.name: urgent-surface
tokens.usage: Background of an urgent guidance card. Text on it: text, soft, danger.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Destructive button label ("Clear all"), on danger-bg (7.7:1).

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Destructive button fill.

tokens.name: danger-border
tokens.usage: Destructive button outline.

tokens.name: notice-ink
tokens.usage: Inline notice text (storage unavailable, import problems), on notice-bg (10:1).

tokens.name: notice-bg
tokens.usage: Inline notice fill.

tokens.name: notice-border
tokens.usage: Inline notice outline.

tokens.name: live-ink
tokens.usage: Value in the live dose preview inside Log intake, on live-bg.

tokens.name: live-note
tokens.usage: Side note in the live dose preview.

tokens.name: live-bg
tokens.usage: Live dose preview fill, translucent green.

tokens.name: live-border
tokens.usage: Live dose preview outline.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Formula text in method code blocks, on track (12:1).

tokens.name: chart-trace
tokens.usage: Legend swatch for the central estimate when no compound colour applies.

tokens.name: chart-band
tokens.usage: Uncertainty band fill (low to high).

tokens.name: chart-band-edge
tokens.usage: Uncertainty band outline in the legend.

tokens.name: chart-now
tokens.usage: The 'now' marker: a 2px vertical line.

tokens.name: chart-bedtime
tokens.usage: The bedtime marker: a 2px vertical line, muted gold.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines.

tokens.name: tooltip-bg
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip fill, near-opaque.

tokens.name: tooltip-border
tokens.usage: Chart tooltip outline.

tokens.name: glow-teal
tokens.usage: Ambient glow, ellipse 850x480 at 8% -12% of the page. Behind everything.

tokens.name: glow-violet
tokens.usage: Ambient glow, ellipse 1100x600 at 97% -13% of the page. Behind everything.

tokens.name: backdrop
tokens.usage: Dialog backdrop, with backdrop-filter: blur(7px).

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Heavy and tight. Weights 700 to 850, tracking -0.035em to -0.055em. This is where the edge lives.

styles.name: intro-title
styles.sample: Track alcohol, caffeine and nicotine, from intake to predicted clearance.
styles.usage: The one headline above the Now section, the largest type on the page. 29px / 1.22 under 1120px, 26px at phone width (under 680px). Balanced wrap. The compound names inside it switch to accent-word.

styles.name: metric-value
styles.usage: The live number on a compound card. Always tabular-nums. 21px at phone width.

styles.name: insight-value
styles.usage: Headline value in an insight tile (At bedtime).

styles.name: brandname
styles.usage: The wordmark beside the brandmark. Nowhere else.

styles.name: stat-value
styles.usage: Values in stat boxes under the chart. Tabular-nums. 14px at phone width.

styles.name: section-title
styles.usage: Section heads above the metrics and history.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Body is 14px / 1.55. Everything else steps down by one or two pixels; there is no size above body for running text.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each preset is an editable starting point, not a laboratory value.
styles.usage: Running text in dialogs and the footer. Paragraphs in soft.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Peak in the next 24 h at 21:40
styles.usage: Card copy, metric footers, table rows.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Button labels. Small buttons drop to 11px.

styles.name: tab
styles.usage: Compound tabs. Segmented pills use 11px at 750.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Panel subtitles, legend, plot notes, fine print. In muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Severity and kicker labels. Always uppercase, always this tracking. Footer column heads use 11px at 0.12em.

groups.name: Accent
groups.note: The one warm, curly voice against the hard sans. System serif italics only, so the offline app still makes no font request.

styles.name: accent-word
styles.usage: A compound name inside intro-title, in that compound's hue. 1.18em evens its x-height with the sans around it. Nowhere else: not in body text, labels, numbers or buttons.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Formulas in the science dialog, in code-ink on track.

spacing.note: Odd, hand-tuned steps (11, 13, 17, 22) rather than a strict 4px grid. Keep them; they are part of why the layout feels drawn, not generated.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside segmented tracks; between tab buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label; toolbar and button-row gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a grid (insight tiles, form fields, guidance cards).

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between metric cards; brandmark to wordmark; dot-grid pitch on the cover.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between panels in the dashboard grid; panel title to content.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding (18px under 1120px).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding; footer grid gap (26px).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on desktop (22px under 1120px, 12px under 680px).

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Space above the site footer.

radius.note: Big, soft outer corners; tighter inside. A nested element always has a smaller radius than its container.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Panels, metric cards, dialogs. The signature corner.

tokens.name: radius-brand
tokens.usage: Brandmark tile; insight tiles; metric cards at phone width.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Guidance cards, empty state, toast, tab track, fine print.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, stat boxes, pill track, history symbol tile, live preview.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Inputs, selects, chart tooltip, code blocks, notices.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, tab buttons.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Segment pills, status badges.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags.

shadow.note: Depth comes from gradients and glow, not drop shadows. Shadows are deep, wide and very soft.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: Anything floating: chart tooltip, toast.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels at rest. Barely there by design.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: The selected segment in a pill control.

tokens.name: shadow-brand
tokens.usage: Halo under the brandmark tile.

layout.note: Breakpoints and fixed sizes from the app's stylesheet.

tokens.name: shell-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page shell.

tokens.name: side-min
tokens.usage: Minimum width of the right column (history) on desktop.

tokens.name: chart-h
tokens.usage: Chart height on desktop.

tokens.name: chart-h-sm
tokens.usage: Chart height under 680px.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Button minimum height (28px for small).

tokens.name: input-h
tokens.usage: Input and select minimum height.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Below this: tighter shell and panel padding, insight grid to 2 columns.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Below this: single-column dashboard; history moves up under the chart.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Below this: phone layout, compact metrics, no metric glow.
